title: S76 — Docs: stale-number sweep across README/JOBS/BENCH (fix only provable staleness)
desc: NEW-OP STARTER. GOAL: compare every numeric claim in README.md, JOBS.md, BENCH.md (and reports index pages) against CURRENT receipts; fix only provable staleness, each change citing its receipt; publish a change log. WHY: README's status line is visibly stale vs the current receipts; S11/S45 covered their eras but nothing guards ongoing drift. STEPS: grep numbers → find the receipt (or mark orphan claim) → update with a dated note + link; leave historical sections date-stamped, never rewrite history. EVIDENCE: docs-only PR + reports/docs-sweep/<date>.md table (claim → receipt → action) + PUSHES row + formalcode line. BOUNDARIES: docs only; a number with NO receipt is flagged, not 'fixed'. Boundaries: no edits to shipping paths unless the task says so; no tuning on canonical seeds 1/2/3/4/53 (evaluation only); honest numbers — no 98/95 claims; captchaproject(s) off-limits.
